notes: Cross-verse split with ROM.4.11. Both verses render an attributive article governing a verbless ἐν ἀκροβυστίᾳ over πίστις, and both write the ASV's supplied lexical verb *he had*; 4.11 gives it to the article and 4.12 gave it to the preposition. Rule 31 gives the preposition the copula, and rule 62 reaches a supplied lexical verb only where the standing prepositional phrase is the predicate of it. Here *in uncircumcision* is an adjunct of *had*, not its predicate, so *he had* is the article's relative clause and ἐν keeps only *in*. s015 and s016 are the only units changed.
